name: Hitman World of Assassination
native_kbm_note: No source found showing keyboard/mouse gameplay support on PS5; console guides list DualSense controls only. Not explicitly confirmed by an official statement.
notes: PC keys come from Feral's official HITMAN (2016) manual, which uses the same Glacier engine and control scheme; WoA's defaults should match but were not checked in-game. M (map) is from keyboardista. PS buttons come from gamertweak (Hitman 3 PS4) and gfinity (R1 tap = reload, hold = Instinct), cross-checked against Feral's numbered gamepad layout. Square = melee / use item (hold), Triangle = interact / pick up (hold), Circle = cover / drag body (hold), Cross = agility / take disguise (hold). D-pad: Feral says left/right = inventory, down = drop, up = holster; gamertweak says down = inventory and left = drop. Feral's layout was used. On PC, G is both use item (hold) and drop item, so G goes to use item and Z (keyboardista) to drop. The wheel zoom on a sniper rifle uses D-pad up/down while aiming, which shares D-pad up with holster.
